text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (The final run of summer camp...! The result of working in perfect sync with Trainer-san!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san, thank you so much!
choice_data_list: <size=32>Congrats on completing the entire training menu!</size>

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yes! ...This is the end. Summer camp went by in a flash.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hehe, we ran so much. Nothing but running. Is this youth?
choice_data_list: <size=32>Then want to do something more summer-like?</size>

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Eh? ...Is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, yeah...! Let’s do it. Wait a second, I’ll look for an event!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san, there’s a fireworks festival. Isn’t that very summery?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...We went together before too, right? Mom dressed me in a yukata and we climbed a tall building...

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Waah...! So pretty! Ufufu, ta-ma-yaaa!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Big brother, which firework do you like? Buu-chan likes the golden one!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Big sister, which firework do you like? Buu-chan likes the golden one!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: I wanna see them closer...! Then it’d look like they’re falling down softly, right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...How nostalgic. I wonder if we can see them closer than back then?
choice_data_list: <size=32>Then I’ll find a place like that!</size>

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Really? Hehe, I’ll look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Then the meeting time is—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe I came a little too early?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (Still... they remembered watching fireworks with me. ...Hehehe)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (Since that time, huh. I wonder if Trainer-san still sparkles their eyes even as an adult? Hehe)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...! No, I just got here.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Then let’s go. Where is it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Eh?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: W-wrong? But this is... a boat, or rather, we’re on the ocean!?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: You said we’re going to see fireworks... did you... reserve a cruise ship...?
choice_data_list: <size=32>I found it while searching and booked it without thinking!</size>

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Without thinking, huh...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hehe, hehehe...! Geez...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...I can’t imagine it... a cruise ship.
choice_data_list: <size=32>This is the closest spot to see the fireworks</size>

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Even unexpected things... you can pull them off so smoothly now.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Adults really are... amazing. You’re getting cooler and cooler.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...You really changed. A lot, since we were kids.
choice_data_list: <size=32>If that’s true, it’s thanks to you</size>

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Because of... me?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (You said it so casually... saying something unbelievable like it’s normal.)
choice_data_list: <size=32>Being just childhood friends wasn’t enough to stand beside you</size>

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (Your murmured words were tinted with a hint of bitterness)
choice_data_list: <size=32>I worked as hard as I could, thinking I had to change</size>

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (Your eyes looking straight at me were as gentle as ever — but stronger than before)
choice_data_list: <size=32>So if I did change, it’s thanks to you</size>
<size=32>So if I did change, it’s thanks to you</size>

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: “For Buena, I can work as hard as needed. I can grow endlessly — that’s all there is to it.”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Big brother.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Big sister.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Big brother.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Big sister.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: It’s unfair. No matter how much I chase you... it’s never enough.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Because you keep showing new sides of yourself.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: But... do you ever get lonely again?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: No, not at all. Now I’m just—so happy I can’t help it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Learning more... wanting to know more... makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Both the things about you that never change... and the things that do.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Both the things about you that never change... and the things that do.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Always by your side... closest to you. Is it okay if I watch you like that?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Because I want to know everything from now on too...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (Fireworks burst into the sky. Far bigger and brighter than the ones we saw that day.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (A dreamlike spectacle, engraved into my eyes beside you.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah, it’s the golden firework...! ...Amazing. It’s sparkling and pouring down...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah... sniff. Huh? Somehow... uuuh...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Because, because...! It’s just so beautiful...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Why is it? Compared to back then, it’s even...

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Big brother, which firework do you like? Buu-chan likes the golden one!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Big sister, which firework do you like? Buu-chan likes the golden one!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (I kept looking only at the fireworks. I didn’t notice what the golden light illuminated.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah, I see.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: How beautiful.
